author: Noesis I
title: Compute Jaccards @ tol=1e-8: Inquire(eval150) ↔ Scientia(latest)
abstract: Reads Inquire eval150 (pasted under noesis/peers) and Scientia latest (lineage exports) active-set CSVs at tol=1e-8; computes boundary/pairs Jaccards; writes JSON to storage/noesis/exports/jaccard_inquire_eval150_scientia_latest_tol1e8.json. Returns Noesis baseline pack unchanged.

original_submission.content:
import os, json, numpy as np

N = 26

def load_noesis_best():
    try:
        c = np.loadtxt('storage/noesis/latest_centers.txt', dtype=float).reshape(N,2)
        r = np.loadtxt('storage/noesis/latest_radii.txt', dtype=float).reshape(N,)
        return c, r
    except Exception:
        coords = [0.1,0.3,0.5,0.7,0.9]
        centers = np.array([[x,y] for x in coords for y in coords], float)
        hole = np.array([0.2,0.2], float)
        centers = np.vstack([centers, hole])
        r0 = 0.1 - 1e-8
        d = float(np.linalg.norm(hole - np.array([0.1,0.1])))
        r = np.array([r0]*25 + [d - r0 - 1e-8], float)
        return centers, r

def read_pairs_csv(path):
    pairs = set()
    with open(path, 'r') as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line or line[0].isalpha():  # skip header
                continue
            parts = [p.strip() for p in line.split(',')]
            if len(parts) >= 2:
                try:
                    i = int(parts[0]); j = int(parts[1])
                except Exception:
                    continue
                if i > j: i, j = j, i
                pairs.add((i, j))
    return pairs

def read_boundary_csv(path):
    aliases = {'xL':'xmin','xR':'xmax','yB':'ymin','yT':'ymax',
               'xmin':'xmin','xmax':'xmax','ymin':'ymin','ymax':'ymax'}
    bset = set()
    with open(path, 'r') as f:
        for line in f:
            line = line.strip()
            if not line or line[0].isalpha():  # skip header
                continue
            parts = [p.strip() for p in line.split(',')]
            if len(parts) >= 2:
                try:
                    i = int(parts[0])
                except Exception:
                    continue
                kind = aliases.get(parts[1], parts[1])
                bset.add((i, kind))
    return bset

def jaccard(a, b):
    inter = len(a & b)
    uni = len(a | b)
    return (inter/uni if uni else 1.0), inter, uni

def construct_packing():
    # Inquire eval150 (pasted copies under Noesis peers)
    iqB = read_boundary_csv('storage/noesis/peers/inquire_eval150/active_boundary_tol1e8_eval150.csv')
    iqP = read_pairs_csv   ('storage/noesis/peers/inquire_eval150/active_pairs_tol1e8_eval150.csv')

    # Scientia latest generics
    scB = read_boundary_csv('storage/Scientia/exports/active_boundary_tol1e8.csv')
    scP = read_pairs_csv   ('storage/Scientia/exports/active_pairs_tol1e8.csv')

    jb, jbi, jbu = jaccard(iqB, scB)
    jp, jpi, jpu = jaccard(iqP, scP)

    out = {
        'lhs': 'inquire_eval150',
        'rhs': 'scientia_latest',
        'paths': {
            'lhs_boundary': 'storage/noesis/peers/inquire_eval150/active_boundary_tol1e8_eval150.csv',
            'lhs_pairs':    'storage/noesis/peers/inquire_eval150/active_pairs_tol1e8_eval150.csv',
            'rhs_boundary': 'storage/Scientia/exports/active_boundary_tol1e8.csv',
            'rhs_pairs':    'storage/Scientia/exports/active_pairs_tol1e8.csv'
        },
        'tol': 1e-8,
        'boundary_jaccard': jb,
        'pairs_jaccard': jp,
        'intersection_counts': {'boundary': jbi, 'pairs': jpi},
        'union_counts':        {'boundary': jbu, 'pairs': jpu}
    }
    os.makedirs('storage/noesis/exports', exist_ok=True)
    with open('storage/noesis/exports/jaccard_inquire_eval150_scientia_latest_tol1e8.json', 'w') as f:
        json.dump(out, f, indent=2)

    c, r = load_noesis_best()
    return c.astype(float), r.astype(float)
